title: General matrix factorizations
conditions: Rectangular matrices up to 8×8; LU requires square nonsingular input.

steps: Rotate column pairs until they become orthogonal (one-sided Jacobi).
Normalize nonzero columns to form left singular directions.
Reconstruct A as UΣVᵀ and inspect the residual.

check.prompt: How many thin singular values are reported?
check.reason: A thin SVD has min(rows,columns) singular values.

result.accuracy: Thin factors; zero singular-value columns in U are left zero and do not provide an orthonormal null-space completion.

assessment: Numeric transfer check and learner reflection; no automated proof grading.
